story.fullStory:
Stranglers's "Skin Deep" — original release 1984. "Skin Deep" is a song by British band the Stranglers, released in September 1984 as the lead single from the album Aural Sculpture.

Artist: Stranglers · Title: Skin Deep · Album: The Stranglers - Skin Deep · Year: 1984 · Genre: New Wave · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/TECHNO/Stranglers - Skin Deep.mp4.

The shimmering and melodic single restored the band to the UK top 20 after its previous two single releases (from the album Feline) had stalled at numbers 48 and 35.

The music video consists of the band performing the song, interspersed with shots of a snake crawling over a person and the band removing face masks towards the end of the video, finishing with a shot of the aural sculpture featured on the parent album cover.
